lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill area, arranged in distinct vertical columns. Larger, more isolated centroids are visible along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a coordinate-like grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges visible along the upper flank, marked by a sharp transition from high-intensity upper boundaries to shaded lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of small, high-luminance spots visible on the dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin.
